bagPolicy.summary: Clear bags must be smaller than an 8.5 x 11 inch sheet of paper. Diaper bags and medical bags are allowed but may be screened. There's no storage for prohibited bags, though Venue Vault smart lockers are available to rent by the restrooms.
allowed: Clear bags smaller than 8.5 x 11 inches
bagPolicy.quote: Clear bags must be smaller than an 8.5" x 11" piece of paper.

parking.summary: Street parking nearby depends on availability. Several downtown garages are close, including the Empire Parking Garage on Montana Avenue between N. Broadway and N. 27th Street.
parking.quote: Nearby street parking is contingent on availability.

rideshare.summary: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Pub Station Ballroom. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.summary: Outside food and drinks aren't allowed. There are two ATMs, one in the lobby and one outside by the ticket window.
concessions.quote: Yes, we have two ATM's. One is located in the lobby and the other is located outside next to the ticket window.

accessibility.summary: The venue is ADA compliant. To reserve an ADA seat, call the office during regular hours at 406-894-2020. Documented service animals are welcome; other pets are not.
accessibility.quote: To reserve an ADA seat, please contact our office during regular office hours at 406-894-2020

reEntry.summary: There's no re-entry. Once you leave, you're out for the night.
reEntry.quote: There is NO RE ENTRY once you are in the venue.

ticketPickup.summary: Tickets are sold only through Etix and at the box office in the Pub Station Taproom in the same building. Everyone needs a full-price ticket regardless of age. Guests 21 and over get a wristband, and anyone under 21 or without valid ID gets X's on both hands.
ticketPickup.quote: Patrons over 21 years of age will be given a wristband.

gates.summary: The time on each event listing is when doors open. Shows usually start about an hour after doors.
gates.quote: The times posted on each event indicate the time that doors open.
